name: TyrantKabuterimon
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.6 w/[Insectoid] trait and play cost 13 or less: Cost 2
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] You may play 1 Digimon card with the [Insectoid] or [Larva] trait from your hand with the play cost reduced by 8.
[All Turns] While this Digimon is suspended, it isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] By suspending 1 of your other Digimon, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as the Digimon this effect suspended to the bottom of the deck.
alt_effect: [Digivolve] Lv.6 w/[Insectoid] trait and play cost 13 or less: Cost 2
